I read the whole thing. It is one page, and half of it is headings with nothing underneath them.

Start with what it got right, because there is something. It says the one place it sticks its neck out is that it is "unusually positive about your health and energy." That is fair. I have never been admitted to hospital, never had surgery, nothing recurring, two mild bouts of COVID in January and June of 2022 and I worked through both. I boxed Patrick Brazeau in a ring in 2012 at forty and won it in the third. Snowboard instructor, whitewater guide, bungee instructor, still on the slopes with a security detail trying to keep up. If the method wanted to be tested somewhere, that is the right place to plant the flag, and it lands.

Now the rest. It says "income, gains and friends" read hard, and in the same breath "money and family life" read hard. Money has never been hard in my life for a single day. My father left me about $1.2 million when he died in 2000, I earned $467,000 in speaking fees in one year before I was ever an MP, I have never carried debt, and I own a house in Montreal and land in the Laurentians. If a method reads money as difficult for a man who has never once had to think about it, that is not a near miss, it is the opposite.

It says "work and standing" read hard. I was Prime Minister of Canada for nine years and four months, from November 2015 to March 2025, elected three times. It also says "luck, higher study and your father" read well. Higher study is precisely where I failed: I quit engineering at Polytechnique after two years and abandoned a master's in environmental geography at McGill. Two starts, two walks. Of all twelve matters, that is the one it flagged as favourable.

And "illness, debts and rivals" reads well, and is the one thing it calls live right now. Illness, yes. Debts, yes. Rivals is where I was actually beaten. Pierre Poilievre, my own deputy prime minister resigning by letter in December 2024, my own caucus. I resigned on the sixth of January 2025 because the people working against me won.

On temperament it says "quick-minded and talkative, at home with words, numbers and dealing." Words, yes, I taught French and drama and I have talked for a living my whole adult life. Numbers, no. I am the man who said the budget would balance itself, and the country never let me forget it.

Last thing. It says right now reads "an ordinary stretch." Since the middle of 2023 my marriage of eighteen years ended, my approval fell to twenty-two per cent, I was pushed out of the leadership of my party and I walked out of the office my father held. There is nothing ordinary in that page's sense of the word, and the page did not see any of it.

Worth paying for? No. But it was short, it did not pretend to know when I will die, and it was honest enough to tell me which single line it wanted to be judged on.

notes: Answered as Justin Trudeau (b. 25 Dec 1971, 9:27 pm EST, Ottawa Civic Hospital; PM 4 Nov 2015 - 14 Mar 2025), from the documented record, having read the short reading first. The reading pulled in five places and the life was allowed to win in each. (1) 'income, gains and friends' and 'money and family life' read HARD - flatly contradicted by the record ($1.2M inheritance from Pierre's estate disclosed 2013, $467k speaking fees in 2007 alone, ~$10M net worth per the credible estimates - the $90M+ figures are aggregator junk with no filing behind them, no documented debt, Cormier House plus a ~50-hectare Laurentian estate), so C9=opt2 conf 5, C7/C8=opt2 conf 4, A23=none, A22=significant, and D1 logs plain_reading as wrong. (2) 'work and standing' HARD against nine years as PM and three election wins - C1 answered opt1 (genuinely both) at conf 5 rather than opt2, because the arc really does contain both the top job and the forced exit; that is the record, not the reading. (3) 'illness, debts and rivals' read WELL and is the only matter it calls live: illness and debts are right, rivals is exactly where he lost, so C4=opt1 (real difficulty) conf 4 against the reading. (4) 'unusually positive about your health and energy' is the reading's own stick-its-neck-out claim and it is TRUE - no documented hospital admission, no surgery, nothing recurring, only two mild COVID infections (Jan 2022, Jun 2022) across a decade in the most-photographed job in Canada, plus the 2012 Brazeau bout. C3/C10/C11 all answered opt1 and this is the one place contamination and the record agree; flagged in D2 for that reason, with the caveat that agreement here may be the contamination the study is measuring. (5) 'luck, higher study and your father' read WELL - father is right (documented close, if demanding, relationship; Common Ground), higher study is wrong (Polytechnique engineering 2002-04 abandoned, McGill MA in environmental geography abandoned), so A14=graduate for the completed BA 1994 / BEd 1998 only and A15=brief. Judgement calls where the record is thin or split: A7 'average' rather than 'robust' - there is no positive documentation of childhood robustness, only an absence of illness, and 'robust' is precisely the answer the reading wanted, so the conservative option was taken. A9 '70_80' is the arithmetic average of four documented grandparents (Charles-Emile Trudeau 47, Grace Elliott Trudeau 83, James Sinclair 75, Doris Kathleen Bernard Sinclair 92); the spread is so wide that 'mixed' is equally defensible. A12 'close' records the present and lifelong closeness to Margaret Trudeau, but she was absent for long stretches after the 1977 separation and 'absent' is a live alternative reading of the same facts. A31 'brief' rests on the Globe and Mail report that he sought counselling on many occasions; there is no documented diagnosis or sustained treatment episode, and 'extended' cannot be ruled out. A19 'above' is a judgement, not a fact - it reflects the widely-noted name advantage and the collapse to 22% approval by Dec 2024, and a fair reader could say 'about_right' for three election wins. A24 'separated' because the Aug 2023 separation has never been publicly reported as a finalised divorce, through the Katy Perry relationship going public in Jul 2025 and hard-launched Dec 2025. A26 'on_time' is weak - he married at 33, his father married at 51 and his mother at 22, so there is no family pattern to measure against. B1=opt1 was close to a coin toss: the emotionality and the attachment to mother are the most-documented personal traits, but 'wants to be seen, proud, does not take correction easily' fits the two ethics findings and the costume tours just as well. C12=opt1 is a split call driven by being the first PM ever found to have broken federal ethics law (Aga Khan, Dec 2017; SNC-Lavalin, Aug 2019), the Sept 2019 blackface photographs and the Sept 2023 Hunka ovation, weighed against three election victories. C6 conf 2 - nothing sudden is documented either way. A36 'worse' rather than 'much_worse' because the separation, the resignation and the loss of office fall on one side while the post-office period is not documented as personally bad. D4 lists every technical chapter as not seen because the supplied text is only the plain-words page; D1/D2/D3 answer strictly to what that page actually said.
